units: <cite ref="Ketubot 8b:10">Keth. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>בעל הג׳ … גְּמוּלְכֶם</he> may He who rewards, pay you for your good deed.—Pl. <he>גְּמוּלִים</he>, <he>גְּמוּלִין</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 13:15">Gen. R. s. 13</cite> <he>ג׳ טובים וכ׳</he> goodness bestowed on the guilty.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 7:9">Tosef. Shebi. VII, 9</cite> <he>ואין משלמין מהן ג׳</he> and favors received must not be repaid with them (the fruits of the Sabbath year); <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 7:9">ib.</cite>
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 1">Deut. R. s. 1</cite> <he>ג׳ אני פורע</he> (some ed. <he>גמי׳</he> incorr.) I repay according to deeds.
